title: Diagnosing Upgrade and Compatibility Problems knowledge check

questions.prompt: Which statement best describes “Diagnosing Upgrade and Compatibility Problems”?
options: It is best handled by removing constraints and skipping error checks.

Record the exact server release, compare its official reference manual and release notes, and label syntax or behavior that changed. Compatibility checks are a release-management task, not a guess based on a major version alone.
It is a frontend styling feature and does not involve database behavior.
It guarantees correct output regardless of schema, permissions, or release version.
questions.answer_key: Record the exact server release, compare its official reference manual and release notes, and label syntax or behavior that changed. Compatibility checks are a release-management task, not a guess based on a major version alone.
questions.explanation: The lesson explains: Record the exact server release, compare its official reference manual and release notes, and label syntax or behavior that changed. Compatibility checks are a release-management task, not a guess based on a major version alone.

questions.prompt: Which practice best applies “Diagnosing Upgrade and Compatibility Problems” safely?
options: Write a read-only diagnostic checklist and identify which output or time range would confirm your hypothesis.
Skip testing, assume every SQL engine behaves identically, and apply the change directly to production.
Concatenate untrusted input into SQL text and grant administrator privileges to every application user.
Judge success only by whether the statement returns any rows, without checking expected behavior or edge cases.
questions.answer_key: Write a read-only diagnostic checklist and identify which output or time range would confirm your hypothesis.
questions.explanation: Write a read-only diagnostic checklist and identify which output or time range would confirm your hypothesis. This makes the result reviewable and aligns with a controlled learning workflow.

questions.prompt: Before relying on an example for “Diagnosing Upgrade and Compatibility Problems”, what should be verified?
options: Run a broad production change before checking the current state.
Ignore version notes and infer behavior from an unrelated database engine.
Assume a successful connection means the query and data model are correct.
Confirm the exact MySQL version and prerequisites, predict the result, run a minimal test in a disposable environment, then inspect the evidence and relevant official documentation.
questions.answer_key: Confirm the exact MySQL version and prerequisites, predict the result, run a minimal test in a disposable environment, then inspect the evidence and relevant official documentation.
questions.explanation: Confirm the exact MySQL version and prerequisites, predict the result, run a minimal test in a disposable environment, then inspect the evidence and relevant official documentation.
